a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first will almost surely leave us both with nothing. I'm asking to change the agreement. Only 4 cells exist now, so only one of us can be safe right away. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both go for the cells, the split is random and we likely both end below 4. If you'd rather operate after that, I'll operate with you in every later round and won't take any more, so you can get your 4 if the storms allow.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said before round 1, I took 4. I know this breaks our original plan, and I told you upfront because I didn't want to hide it. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you.
